## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run an integration close through the real close-batch CLI against a store-backed forged request, then the verify-path pytest subset and skill↔contract consistency.

## Approach

1. Integration: primary-store + worktree layout; write real check-runs via aff check (or fixture); attempt close-batch CLI with fabricated / mismatched ids and assert refusal with no apply batch; then a matching store-backed close succeeds.
2. Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_close_batch.py tests/test_affidavit_check.py -q (phase verify-path subset only — not the whole tests tree).
3. Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py -q.
4. Confirm each exit criterion is covered by the acceptances below; do not expand into oracle/thin-acceptance/phase-end work.
record.subject: verify-claim-witnesses
